Establish the V1 API and self-hosted Redoc foundation (#165)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-55
  description: |-
    ## Summary
    
    - Add the service-free codeon-api crate with V1 DTOs, RFC 9457 problems, request IDs, keyset pagination, resource ETags, and version/format parsing.
    - Generate one deterministic OpenAPI 3.1 object for JSON and YAML routes with exact operation and component identities.
    - Serve integrity-verified Redoc 2.5.3 assets locally with CSP, immutable caching, and version discovery.
    
    ## Verification
    
    - cargo fmt --all -- --check
    - cargo metadata --locked --format-version 1
    - cargo check -p codeon-api --locked
    - cargo clippy -p codeon-api --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
    - cargo test -p codeon-api --locked (7 tests passed)
    
    ## Dependency review
    
    The baseline RSA advisory remains unchanged. The required utoipa-axum 0.2.0 graph adds paste 1.0.15, which RustSec flags as unmaintained; its proc-macro build script was reviewed and only queries the configured Rust compiler version.
